summary: Verified DebtFollowUp page settlement order feature. All 5 test cases passed: manual amount input exists for each row, settlement order button exists for each row, clicking button creates payment_order with correct partner info, amount comes from manual input, page doesn't crash after operation.

✅ Settlement order button (data-testid: debt-row-settlement-order-{rowId}) present for each debt row
✅ Input placeholder shows default ajelBalance value (e.g., 350.00)
✅ Clicking settlement order creates payment_order via POST /api/operations
✅ Created operation has correct partnerType (customer/supplier) and partnerName
✅ Created operation amount matches manual input (tested with 150.00)
✅ Toast message 'تم إنشاء أمر السداد بنجاح' shown on success
✅ Page remains stable after settlement order creation (no crash)
